papers.title_en: SlackSwap: Bandwidth-Aware Activation Swapping and Recomputation for Memory-Efficient DNN Training
papers.authors: Hui Feng, Xun Zhou, Yuxin Wang
papers.evidence: 面向大模型GPU训练的带宽感知激活管理
papers.tldr: 现代GPU算力增长远快于主机链路带宽，传统激活换出会因传输阻塞降速，而单纯检查点又浪费可用带宽。SlackSwap把前向阶段链路空闲时间视为显式预算，优先换出重算代价高的激活，并对其余部分选择低代价重算。它以一次性能剖析生成换出与预取计划，采用先进先出换出和最早截止期优先预取，避免逐层同步。在A100仿真中，该方法在激活内存减半时保持接近无限内存吞吐，并快速逼近遗传搜索最优方案，表明换出与重算应按带宽—计算协同分配。
papers.abstract_en: Swapping saved activations to host memory once enabled GPUs to train models that exceeded their device-memory capacity when compute throughput and host-link bandwidth were roughly balanced. For example, on a 2015 Titan X, PCIe bandwidth was sufficient to offload all VGG-16 activations during the forward pass. This balance no longer holds. From the Titan X to the H100, peak training throughput increased by 141x, whereas host-link bandwidth improved by only 3.9x. On an A100, the host link can hide transfers for only 11-38% of the activations in the transformer models we study. Existing swapping approaches, such as vDNN, SuperNeurons, and SwapAdvisor, offload tensors according to memory requirements without explicitly respecting the available link-time budget, resulting in transfer-induced stalls; block checkpointing, in contrast, leaves the host link underutilized. We present SlackSwap, which treats host-link time as an explicit resource budget. Using a single profiled iteration, SlackSwap allocates the forward-pass link budget to tensors that are most expensive to recompute, resolves the remaining memory deficit by recomputing the least expensive tensors, and schedules FIFO offloads and earliest-deadline-first prefetches without per-layer synchronization barriers. In trace-driven simulations of BERT-Large, GPT-2 XL, and a Llama-7B-style model on an A100, SlackSwap retains 96-100% of unlimited-memory GPU throughput while using half the activation memory, achieving 1.10-1.11x the throughput of the best baseline. Its plans are within 0.5% of a genetic search over 6,600-14,000 candidate plans, while requiring less than 0.4 seconds to generate.

papers.title_en: PageWeaver: KV-Guided Query Unions for Sparse Attention
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Li, Zihan Li, Zefang Yuan, Lei Wang, Hao Wang
papers.evidence: 面向稀疏大模型注意力的GPU内核执行优化
papers.tldr: 动态稀疏注意力虽为每个查询选择少量KV页，但若查询间缺乏协同，GPU难以充分复用页加载和填满Tensor Core计算块。PageWeaver按已选页面亲和性组装查询联合，同时保持各查询原始支持集与输出归属，并以双CTA内核直接消费查询ID。H200上Union8相对实测FlashInfer完整调用几何均速1.70倍，在线重组在多项64K样本再降3.26%—7.66%延迟，表明执行分组复用有效但收益受准备开销与基础内核强度制约。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic sparse attention limits the KV pages selected by each query, but a small support does not necessarily yield efficient GPU work. Query unions share page loads and populate Tensor Core tiles; their cost depends on which queries are grouped together. We present PageWeaver, an execution design that uses selected-page affinity to assemble query groups while preserving each query's original support and complete output ownership. A bounded GPU search produces query IDs, and an ID-aware two-CTA kernel consumes them without materializing reordered Q tensors or cross-page partial outputs. A direct KV-page union implementation provides a complementary design study of nonlocal reuse and reduction cost. With FP8 KV throughout, the H200 Union8 implementation achieves a 1.70x geometric-mean complete-call speedup over the measured FlashInfer path on six captures. Online regrouping further lowers latency by 3.26-7.66% on five selected 64K-context captures. Whole-model prefill throughput is 7.88-14.36% above the tested native path; the incremental regrouping benefit is smaller, with observed median gains of 0.47-0.73% at 32K/64K and regressions at 8K. A B300 comparison identifies cases where preparation cost and a stronger native kernel remove the advantage. These results separate execution-group reuse from the complete cost of exploiting it online.

papers.title_en: Byzantine-Resilient Federated Large Language Model via Hypergraph Message Passing
papers.authors: Kai Li, Hanlin Cai, Zihao Liu, Yichen Li, Jose Alcaraz Calero, Wei Ni, Falko Dressler, Özgür B. Akan
papers.evidence: 具备拜占庭韧性的联邦大语言模型训练与聚合
papers.tldr: 联邦大语言模型虽能在不共享原始数据的前提下协同训练，却易受拜占庭恶意更新影响，导致语义一致性和事实可靠性受损。论文将低秩模型更新构造成超图节点，提出超图消息传递图自编码器HMP-GAE，结合历史检查点和跨客户端高阶关系识别并抑制异常更新。在Qwen-2.5、Llama-3.2及AG News、Yahoo! Answers实验中，较现有防御准确率提升1.21%，语义熵下降44.08%，困惑度下降13.34%。该方法无需访问私有本地数据，为可信FedLLM知识聚合提供了语义层面的鲁棒防线。
papers.abstract_en: Federated Large Language Models (FedLLMs) are promising to deliver privacy-preserving, collaborative intelligence. The decentralized training process is vulnerable to Byzantine attacks that corrupt semantic consistency and factual resilience through malicious model updates. This paper presents a new resilience strategy that prevents semantically corrupted knowledge from propagating during federated aggregation. A defense problem is formulated to jointly maximize global accuracy and suppress manipulated model updates, enabling trustworthy knowledge aggregation without accessing private local data. To strengthen the resilience of FedLLMs, we develop a novel Hypergraph Message Passing Graph Autoencoder (HMP-GAE) framework, where low-rank model updates are represented as nodes in a hypergraph and high-order semantic relationships among multiple agents are exploited through iterative message passing. By leveraging historical checkpoints and cross-agent relational reasoning, HMP-GAE identifies and suppresses semantically inconsistent updates while preserving knowledge alignment among agents throughout federated training. HMP-GAE is implemented using Qwen-2.5 and Llama-3.2 as pretrained FedLLM backbones and evaluated on AG News and Yahoo! Answers datasets. Compared to existing defenses, HMP-GAE improves global accuracy by $1.21$\%, reduces final-model classification semantic entropy by $44.08$\%, and lowers perplexity by $13.34$\%. HMP-GAE outperforms the GAE-based defense by improving the accuracy $1.39$\%, reducing the semantic entropy by $54.5$\%, and lowering perplexity by $35.5$\%.

papers.title_en: Minions: A Dynamic and Distributed Virtual GPU Cloud Built on Idle Apple Silicon Devices
papers.authors: Jianhua Li, Yun Xing, Girisha De Silva, Ryan Flint, Kai Yuan, Sean Suchter
papers.evidence: 面向机器学习推理的分布式虚拟GPU云基础设施
papers.tldr: 集中式GPU基础设施面临采购成本高、弹性不足及资源紧张时排队时间长等问题，而大量搭载Apple Silicon的macOS设备GPU在日常使用中闲置。Minions将这些异构空闲设备动态聚合为虚拟GPU云，用于大规模机器学习推理。系统支持灵活任务执行、故障容错与资源高效利用。实践表明，在集中式GPU受限的环境中，既有苹果设备可成为无需新增采购的实用分布式推理平台。
papers.abstract_en: The increasing demand for GPU-accelerated machine learning inference has exposed limitations in centralized GPU infrastructures, including high cost, limited elasticity, and long wait times under resource constraints. At the same time, modern Apple Silicon-based macOS devices are equipped with powerful GPUs that remain largely idle during normal usage. This paper presents Minions, a dynamic and distributed virtual GPU cloud that aggregates idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices to execute large-scale machine learning inference workloads. Minions enables teams to leverage existing hardware without requiring additional GPU procurement. The system provides flexible GPU inference task execution, fault tolerance, and efficient resource utilization. Our experience shows that idle macOS devices can be transformed into a practical distributed GPU inference platform in environments where centralized GPU resources are constrained.

papers.title_en: Ember: Making Unified Virtual Memory Practical for Discrete-Memory GPUs
papers.authors: Senad-Leandro Lemes Galera, Michail Georgoulakis Misegiannis, Ferdinand Gruber, Jana Giceva, Dimitrios Stavrakakis
papers.evidence: 面向超额订阅负载的 GPU 内存管理
papers.tldr: 离散显存GPU的工作集超过显存后，传统UVM依赖缺页迁移，既浪费互连带宽也使GPU利用不足。Ember以混合地址空间让数据初始留在主存，再通过硬件计数器识别热点区域并提升至显存，批量回收冷区并在线重放置。其无需应用修改、放置提示或预分析。在1.5倍超额订阅下，Ember较UVM提速6.8至10.6倍，并显著提升无法手动放置的大模型生成性能，使通用GPU内存超额订阅更实用。
papers.abstract_en: GPU working sets have outgrown GPU memory, so applications must oversubscribe it, keeping only hot data on the GPU. NVIDIA's Unified Virtual Memory (UVM) supports oversubscription, but its performance degrades once data exceeds the GPU's memory. This stems from its fault-driven data placement, wasting interconnect bandwidth, and underutilizing the GPU. This raises the question: can UVM oversubscription become practical on stock GPUs, exploiting GPU memory speed and minimizing wasted interconnect bandwidth, without placement hints, profiling runs, or application changes?   To this end, we present Ember, a UVM management framework for oversubscribed workloads. Ember introduces a hybrid address space; allocations start as mapped into host memory, omitting data migration. Ember's counter-driven region promotion uses GPU's hardware counters to fetch hot regions to the GPU, its decay-based eager reclamation proactively evicts cold regions in batches, while via online region re-placement, Ember tracks the hot set at runtime.   We implement Ember within NVIDIA's open-source UVM driver for unmodified applications and as a userspace variant on stock CUDA. At 1.5x oversubscription, it is 6.8-10.6x faster than UVM on six applications across three PCIe GPUs, and generates LLM tokens 4.7-16x faster at sizes where manual placement cannot run at all. Without a profiling run, it beats a profile-guided alternative by 2.1x on kernel time.

papers.title_en: FlexiFlow: Bandit-based Model Switching in ML Workflows
papers.authors: Abhilash Jindal, Todd Nief, Bhanu Prakash Vangala, Shankaradithyaa V, Tvisha Malik, Anshik Sahu, Aaron Schein, Amitabh Chaudhary, Tanu Malik
papers.evidence: 面向机器学习工作流推理的自适应数据流系统
papers.tldr: 在多阶段机器学习工作流中，固定使用单一模型难以覆盖所有数据批次，局部低准确率会拖累整体效果。FlexiFlow在当前模型表现不足时动态切换候选模型，并复用已有中间结果以避免重复计算。系统以结合运行时间、断言通过概率和工作流计算结构的多臂老虎机方法学习模型排序。实验表明，模型切换最高可将工作流准确率提升23%，相较顺序执行获得48%的效率增益，为复杂真实工作流提供了自适应优化机制。
papers.abstract_en: Model optimizations help improve inference performance and accuracy of ML workflows. However, relying on a single model to perform inference across all data batches often fails to maximize accuracy and thus overall performance. In many cases, alternate models could perform better on specific subsets of data where a primary model underperforms. Our experiments with real ML workflows indeed show that switching models improves workflow accuracy by up to 23%. Yet, current systems lack the ability to adaptively switch between models based on performance, forcing users to manually test models in sequence. We present FlexiFlow, a dataflow system that dynamically switches between alternate models when the current model exhibits low accuracy. FlexiFlow learns to rank models using a novel multi-armed bandit approach that accounts for model runtimes, probability of passing user-defined assertions, and the computational structure of the ML workflow. We show that the standard Thompson sampling approach is insufficient for switching models in ML workflows. In contrast, our proposed approaches are effective and scales to complex real-world ML workflows. Experiments show that switching models at runtime while reusing intermediate results provides higher accuracy, but also 48% efficiency gain compared to sequential workflow runs.

papers.title_en: Fed-BRDECS: Privacy-Preserving and Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Deep Embedded Clustering
papers.authors: Haemin Park, Diego Klabjan, Martin W. Braun, Xiuqi Li, Balakrishnan Ananthanarayanan
papers.evidence: 面向异构数据的去中心化联邦训练框架
papers.tldr: 联邦深度聚类需在不共享原始无标签数据的前提下学习可聚类表示，但传统DEC依赖全局软分配统计，易泄露客户端敏感信息且受非独立同分布影响。Fed-BRDECS以本地样本稳定性损失替代全局归一化目标，并结合预测均衡采样和质心级重启。其在图像、文本的独立同分布及非独立同分布划分中均优于代表性基线，也可提升联邦时序异常检测且不增加推理开销。该工作为隐私友好、抗异质的联邦无监督表示学习提供了实用途径。
papers.abstract_en: Federated deep clustering seeks to learn clustering-friendly representations from decentralized unlabeled data while preserving client privacy. However, Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC)-style objectives depend on global soft-assignment statistics that require clients to reveal their sensitive information. We propose Fed-BRDECS, a privacy-preserving and heterogeneity-aware federated deep embedded clustering framework. Fed-BRDECS replaces the globally normalized clustering objective with a locally computable sample-stability loss, avoiding the transmission of local soft-assignment distributions. To tackle non-IID client distributions, we introduce prediction-balanced sampling, which oversamples locally rare predicted clusters without requiring ground-truth labels, and centroid-level restarting, which periodically refreshes biased or inactive centroids. Experiments on image and text clustering benchmarks show that Fed-BRDECS consistently outperforms representative federated clustering and deep clustering baselines under both IID and non-IID partitions. We further demonstrate its applicability to federated time-series anomaly detection, where it improves reconstruction-based detectors without adding inference-time cost.

papers.title_en: BARE-AI: Bit-Flip Attack Resilience in AI Hardware through Built-in Performance Monitors
papers.authors: Habibur Rahaman, Swastik Bhattacharya, Sanjay Das, Kanad Basu, Swarup Bhunia
papers.evidence: 面向AI加速器的运行时监控与韧性框架
papers.tldr: 深度神经网络在安全关键设备中易遭少量内存位翻转攻击，准确率可急剧下降，而现有防护常有较高硬件代价或依赖重训练。BARE-AI在推理期以片上性能计数器采集逐层激活统计，由轻量检测器识别攻击，并通过异常层定位与权重修复恢复模型。其在视觉模型检测率最高98%，语言模型为74%—95%，CNN和视觉Transformer可接近干净精度。28纳米实现的能耗、面积开销分别低于3%、4%，且开销不随攻击翻转数增长，适合资源受限的边缘安全场景。
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are integral to many safety critical systems, yet they remain highly vulnerable to bit-flip attacks (BFAs), where a few memory level perturbations can drastically degrade accuracy. Existing defenses incur significant hardware overhead, depend on retraining, or fail against targeted flips. We propose BARE-AI, a runtime framework that detects, localizes, and mitigates BFAs during inference. BARE-AI introduces AI Performance Counters (APCs), lightweight hardware monitors in the accelerator datapath that capture per-layer activation statistics such as sparsity, entropy, kurtosis, and spectral shift. These are analyzed by the Predictive Unit for Layer Security Evaluation (PULSE), a compact detector trained offline as an ensemble of classifiers and realized on-chip as a small neural engine. For explainability and recovery, BARE-AI introduces an Activation Shift Index (ASI) for layer level fault localization and a z-score based repair that resets anomalous weights toward clean layer statistics. Across CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Large Language Models under random, targeted, adaptive, and magnitude based BFAs, BARE-AI achieves up to 98% detection accuracy on vision models and 74% to 95% on language models, restores near clean accuracy for CNNs and ViTs, and provides partial recovery for LLMs. Synthesized at 28nm, the monitoring infrastructure incurs under 3% energy, under 4% area, and about 10% latency overhead, with a configurable operating point that reduces latency overhead to about 6%. Unlike error correcting codes, whose redundancy grows with the number of tolerated flips, BARE-AI's overhead remains constant regardless of attack strength, making it attractive for resource constrained, safety critical edge applications such as autonomous systems, energy, and healthcare.

papers.title_en: FedRSPO+: A Heterogeneity-aware Algorithm for Decision-focused Federated Learning
papers.authors: Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos, Alexander Vinel, Jiaqi Wang
papers.evidence: 异构性处理的联邦学习算法
papers.tldr: 决策导向学习需直接优化下游决策质量，但联邦跨机构场景中，客户端的目标函数与可行域差异会使线性规划最优解突变，导致本地更新和聚合不稳定。FedRSPO+以正则化预测—优化代理RSPO+通过投影平滑决策映射，并采用退火式模块化联邦训练。理论上给出决策误差、遗憾及跨客户端异质性界，实验在背包、最短路和能源定价任务中验证其稳定协作决策学习能力。
papers.abstract_en: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictive models for downstream optimization, but existing methods largely assume centralized data. In cross-silo settings, federated learning offers a natural alternative, yet standard federated methods optimize prediction over decision quality and do not address heterogeneity in downstream objectives or feasible sets. This heterogeneity is especially challenging for DFL because small perturbations in polyhedral problems can cause discontinuous changes in optimal decisions, destabilizing client updates and aggregation. We propose FedRSPO+, a heterogeneity-aware framework for decision-focused federated learning, built on RSPO+, a regularized predict-then-optimize surrogate that smooths the decision map through projection. We show that RSPO+ upper bounds decision error and regret for the regularized decision and, under exact regularization and consistent LP solution selection, for the original LP decision. We further derive cross-client heterogeneity bounds that depend on both objective and feasible-set heterogeneity, vanish at homogeneity, and require no strong convexity. FedRSPO+ uses an annealed, modular training procedure compatible with standard federated personalization and aggregation methods. Experiments on synthetic knapsack, shortest-path, and real-world energy pricing tasks compare against prediction-only federated learning and DFL baselines under varying heterogeneity and communication budgets. Results suggest that smoothing is a useful ingredient for stable collaborative decision learning and provide a heterogeneity-aware foundation for federated DFL.

papers.title_en: Lightweight and Versatile Learned Optimization by Recombination of Gradient History
papers.authors: Minyoung Choi, Dalta Imam Maulana, Wanyeong Jung
papers.evidence: 用于高效模型训练的低开销学习型优化器
papers.tldr: 现有学习型优化器往往依赖长梯度历史与较大元网络，训练和部署成本限制了跨任务泛化。本文将不相交时间段上的梯度均值作为历史表示，并为每个均值预测可被多参数共享的单一重组系数。通过对更早梯度逐步平均，在保留独立贡献通道的同时压低存储开销。仅3.7万参数、0.87 GPU小时训练后，该方法零样本提升语言、视觉和图任务表现，显示出轻量通用学习优化的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a lightweight and versatile learned optimizer that dynamically recombines gradient history, represented as averages over disjoint time spans. The optimizer reduces the prediction space to one scalar coefficient per gradient average, shared by multiple parameters. Progressively averaging older gradients minimizes memory cost of long history, while keeping their contributions independently accessible. A 37k-parameter network trained in 0.87 GPU-hours generalizes zero-shot to unseen tasks, lowering validation loss by 9.1% and 0.4% on BERT-Tiny and GPT-Tiny, and improving test accuracy over Adam by 3.5 %p on a Vision Transformer and by 2.7 %p on average across nine graph models, with FLOPs overhead as low as 0.3%.

papers.title_en: FedSSMCoOp: SSM Encoders for light-weight Federated Prompt Learning for Few-shot Classification
papers.authors: Ankita Das, Ambarish Parthasarathy, Sumohana S. Channappayya, C. Krishna Mohan
papers.evidence: 面向数据异构的轻量级联邦提示学习
papers.tldr: 联邦生物医学少样本分类中，各机构数据不能共享、标注稀缺且分布差异大，传统视觉—语言模型以余弦相似度对齐，难以建模词元结构和跨模态交互。FedSSMCoOp以Vision Mamba和Cross Mamba实现多模态编码，仅在联邦训练中更新软提示与通信提示，无需外部大语言模型。多项生物医学数据集评测显示，该方法相对基线性能稳定，平均模型更轻1.96倍，为隐私受限场景提供了高效提示学习方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance across a wide range of downstream vision tasks, thanks to the complementary information contained in the respective domains. Despite the performance gains, most of these approaches rely on aligning these domains using the cosine similarity metric, which fails to capture token-level structure and cross-modal interactions prior to the classification stage. This is especially critical in biomedical applications under federated constraints, where data sharing is restricted, labeled data is scarce at each site, and it differs widely across institutions, leading to substantial statistical heterogeneity. To overcome this issue, we propose FedSSMCoOp, a federated few-shot image classification framework that enables multimodal learning while preserving data privacy. With the help of the SSM-based Vision Mamba and Cross Mamba blocks, and by optimizing only the soft-prompt and communication-prompt updates in the federated setting, the framework prioritizes both computation and performance. Importantly, this eliminates the need to use an external Large Language Model (LLM) for feature alignment. The framework is further trained and evaluated on various biomedical image datasets, and its performance is assessed. The proposed framework delivers stable performance relative to the baselines and is, on average, 1.96 times lighter. The corresponding script will be made available soon.

papers.title_en: The Optimization Landscape of Learning Compacted Context Models
papers.authors: Thomas Villeneuve, Alex Sandomirsky, Charles O'Neill, Max Kirkby, Michael Psenka
papers.evidence: 面向长上下文模型的KV缓存压缩与内存优化
papers.tldr: 面向持续学习中不断增长的上下文与KV缓存，本文研究在冻结基座模型条件下学习少量KV向量以复现完整缓存行为的难题。作者指出，此类压缩优化因需穿过冻结模型而呈现脆弱且平坦的损失景观。为此，提出大幅简化的Perceiver式上下文压缩架构，并分析优化困难来源。在金融、法律、古腾堡文本和代码的选择题任务上，该方法达到完整Perceiver Transformer水平，并在压缩效用上超过基线，说明简化结构可改善可训练性和实际记忆压缩价值。
papers.abstract_en: Many works approach continual learning through the lens of infinite context windows. As an agent puts more observation into context (concretely the KV cache), compacting said context is akin to direct memory manipulation, without affecting the base model's weights. Many works pose KV compaction as an optimization problem: learn a smaller set of KV vectors that matches the behavior of the full KV cache. While this preserves base model behavior, optimizing through a frozen base model results in a highly nontrivial optimization problem with a brittle and flat loss landscape. In this paper, we characterize what makes these optimization problems difficult and demonstrate that a heavily simplified Perceiver-based architecture not only matches performance of a full Perceiver transformer in continuous context compaction, but outperforms baselines on compaction utility. Results are presented on MCQ tasks across Finance, Legal, Gutenberg, and Code.

papers.title_en: A Solvable Model of Adaptive Learning Rate Rescaling: Acceleration, Stability & Scaling
papers.authors: Itay Lavie, Clarissa Lauditi, Cengiz Pehlevan
papers.evidence: 针对归一化随机梯度下降的训练扩展理论
papers.tldr: 现代优化器常通过归一化更新幅度来摆脱原始梯度范数约束，但其对收敛曲线及宽度、批量资源缩放的影响尚不清楚。论文在具有幂律教师与数据协方差的随机特征模型中解析研究归一化随机梯度下降，并建立动力学平均场理论。归一化早期显著加速收敛，但有限步长下会因反馈失稳而进入临界稳定状态。该理论统一解释加速、稳定性边界及宽度—批量配置，并获线性化ResNet实验支持。
papers.abstract_en: A recurring design principle in modern optimizers is to decouple update magnitude from the raw gradient norm, yet its consequences for learning-curve and resource scaling remain unclear. We isolate this mechanism by studying normalized SGD in a random-feature model with power-law teacher and data covariance. Fixed-norm updates induce an effective learning rate that grows as gradients shrink. We derive a dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) describing the joint dependence of the loss on training time, model width and batch size. Normalization initially accelerates SGD, mapping the power-law exponent $r_{\rm SGD}<1$ to $2r_{\rm SGD}/(1-r_{\rm SGD})$, with exponential convergence at $r_{\rm SGD}=1$ and formal finite-time convergence for $r_{\rm SGD}>1$. At finite step size, however, the same feedback ultimately breaks the acceleration and leads to marginal stability. The late-time theory yields width-limited, edge-of-stochastic-stability (EoSS), and deterministic edge-of-stability (EoS) regimes. These phases determine when larger batches or wider models reduce serial training time at comparable compute. We quantify in which of these phases increased batch size or width can compensate the excess compute use per step by fewer optimization steps to target loss. Linearized ResNet experiments on CIFAR-5M support the predicted acceleration, breakdown, and resource-scaling trends. Together, these results connect normalization-induced acceleration, EoS effects, and width--batch allocation within a solvable theory.

papers.title_en: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
papers.authors: Benhao Huang, Chufan Shi, Junlin Chen, Shicheng Wen, Zhengzhong Liu, Eric Xing, Xuezhe Ma
papers.evidence: 通过固定点方法降低循环大模型训练、解码和预填充成本
papers.tldr: 循环语言模型的每次递推都会增加训练、解码、预填充和强化学习成本，而状态接近固定点后，中间路径的重要性下降。论文围绕固定点重设计深度先验与输入注入：从预测反馈学习保持宽度的深度分布，并用正交注入消除状态沿输入方向的放大或抵消。该设计支持截断反传、末端KV共享、快速蒸馏预填充和基于保存状态的RL更新。在1.6B参数上，小3倍KV缓存即可达到固定深度全缓存的下游平均表现。
papers.abstract_en: Every recurrence of a looped language model adds cost in training, decoding, prefill, and reinforcement learning (RL). The closer recurrent states get to fixed points, the less the path to them matters. This enables truncated backpropagation in training; terminal key-value (KV) sharing for decoding with almost no loss in accuracy; a distilled student that prefills up to 1.79x faster; and RL updates that compute gradients from saved rollout states, 2x faster than backpropagating through the replayed trajectory. We therefore improve the two components of training that shape these fixed points: the depth prior and input injection. Fixed-depth training breaks KV sharing, and Huginn's broad depth prior supports sharing but dilutes supervision at the target depth more than sharing requires; we learn the prior from prediction feedback, with an entropy term that keeps it broad. Existing injection schemes let the state's component along the input amplify or cancel the injection; we remove this component with orthogonal injection. From 100M to 1.6B parameters, the learned prior and orthogonal injection lower perplexity at every scale relative to Huginn's prior and existing injection schemes, respectively. At 1.6B, the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.

papers.title_en: Stepped MoE: Segment-Level Routing with Configurable Inference Complexity
papers.authors: Arnav Kundu, Zhaoyang Xu, Bairu Hou, Chang Gao, Reed Li, Tao Lei
papers.evidence: 面向资源受限部署的可配置稀疏大模型架构
papers.tldr: 大语言模型面向端侧部署时，既要适配不同内存与算力预算，也需按输入难度动态分配计算，现有弹性网络与稀疏路由通常割裂设计。Stepped MoE将弹性嵌套子网络和稀疏门控统一，使主干同时条件于上下文与目标效率规格，并在分段级别选择任务相关参数。单一模型可覆盖10亿至40亿参数容量点；在知识密集基准上较同规模稠密模型高2%—5%，延迟与静态版本及稠密模型相近。该方案通过共享参数节省设备磁盘空间，并支持按DRAM和计算资源灵活服务。
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) is resource-intensive, and adapting them for diverse deployment scenarios with varying computational constraints remains challenging. While elastic architectures enable flexible model deployment and sparsely activated models allow input-adaptive computation, existing approaches treat these dimensions independently. Moreover, models catered towards on-device edge inference need to conform to the memory and compute limitations of the serving devices. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that combines elastic structures with sparsely gated architectures to create models that adapt simultaneously to both deployment constraints and task requirements. Our approach employs a model backbone that conditions on both the context and target efficiency specifications, enabling fine-grained control over the accuracy-efficiency trade-off at inference time. The model learns to activate task-relevant parameters within elastically-nested sub-networks, allowing a single model to span multiple capacity points while maintaining input-adaptive routing. Through experiments we demonstrate that we can create a model that allows the flexibility to use 1,2,3,4 billion parameters while being more accurate than their dense counter-parts (2-5\% on knowledge-intensive benchmarks) and at par with their static versions while delivering similar latency metrics as dense models. Overall, we save on device disk space by sharing the model parameters, allow flexibility of serving based on DRAM and compute available while delivering more accurate results.

papers.title_en: WarpDRF: Data-Race Freedom for Warp-Level Programming
papers.authors: Zheyuan Chen, Simon Kagle, Tiago Cogumbreiro, Tyler Sorensen
papers.evidence: 保障高性能AI内核可靠性的GPU编程模型
papers.tldr: 张量核、洗牌、归约与屏障等warp原语的参与线程会受分歧、重汇合及独立线程调度动态影响，但既有语言缺少明确且经验证的数据竞争自由契约。论文提出WarpDRF抽象模型，以可参数化的参与规则和原语要求刻画不同语言。Rocq证明满足该契约的内核与参考语义结果一致；在五种语言、16种设备与后端上完成大规模一致性测试，并发现llama.cpp中三处未知竞争。工作为可靠分析和检查高性能GPU内核提供实证基础。
papers.abstract_en: Warp primitives such as tensor core operations, shuffles, reductions, and barriers are critical to high-performance GPU kernels, and every major GPU language supports some set of them. The threads that participate in a primitive, and therefore synchronize, are determined dynamically by how threads diverge and reconverge, and by intra-warp scheduling such as independent thread scheduling. In practice, many high-performance kernels use these primitives and behave as expected, following an intuitive but unwritten data-race-freedom contract that has never been stated precisely or empirically tested.   We present WarpDRF, the first abstract warp programming model to make this contract precise, with participation rules parameterized by reconvergence guarantees and per-primitive requirements so that instantiations match different GPU languages. We prove (formalized in Rocq) that a kernel satisfying WarpDRF executes every warp primitive with the participants the reference semantics assigns and produces the same results, so a programmer can reason in the reference semantics alone. We implement the model in MLIR with a reference interpreter and fuzz 10K conformance tests for each of three configurations across CUDA, HIP, HLSL, Metal, and SPIR-V on 16 device and backend pairs; at least one WarpDRF configuration describes each, with CUDA honoring the strictly weakest configuration. Finally, we extend Faial, a static data-race analyzer for CUDA, into the first DRF checker for an empirically validated warp model, and apply it to llama.cpp, where most kernels that use warp primitives already satisfy the contract, but three contain previously unknown data races, showing the need for tools that check it.
